header: L1 · The developer who uses it every day · sonnet
verdict: Both round-10 L1 findings read as resolved at the baseline. One advisory from the delta: the salvage fingerprint hashes every untracked and ignored file on a rerun after a failed removal.

findings.defect: The fingerprint that gates the resume of a removing generation digests untracked and ignored paths, each with the digest of its file, and no page says what that costs or when the user sees it.
findings.scenario: sbx env rm fails once on a Mac with several clones holding node_modules or target dirs. The user reruns romeu rm and waits, with no output and no budget, while every ignored file is hashed; the user concludes the tool hung and interrupts it, leaving the generation removing.
findings.change: State in 3.8 or 04 that the fingerprint step prints a progress line, or that ignored paths are digested by path, size and mtime; or name the expected cost in the resume row.

out_of_scope: Pages 10, 11, 12, plan and the ADR skimmed by stat only. L1-r10-1 stays as the round-10 resolution states it: J1 step 5 names no askpass program and points at probe B2 for the outcome without one. I did not re-raise that.
confidence: Medium: prior items checked by reading baseline text; the new finding rests on reading the 3.8 fingerprint definition, not on a measurement.
